commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) gets on the end of a cross but produces a tame shot from the edge of the area which goes well wide of the right post.
90+4' Rayo Vallecano have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

90+4' The ball is crossed into the box and Radamel Falcao (Rayo Vallecano) reacts quickest to send a shot flying towards the middle of the goal, but Unai Simon gets a glove on it to thwart him. Rayo Vallecano win a corner.
90+2' A clumsy foul by Ander Herrera (Ath Bilbao) and Francisco Maeso blows his whistle. A free kick is awarded to Rayo Vallecano.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
89' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao will have a goal kick.
87' Radamel Falcao (Rayo Vallecano) is shown a yellow card for a late challenge.
85' A player from Rayo Vallecano commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
85' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Rayo Vallecano, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
85' Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for a foul after Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) hacks down one of his opponents. Rayo Vallecano will take a free kick near the side line.
85' Iker Muniain (Ath Bilbao) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
84' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Dani Vivian walks off the pitch to be replaced by Peru Nolaskoain (Ath Bilbao).
82' Iker Muniain (Ath Bilbao) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
81' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor decides to make a substitution. Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta will be replaced by Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao).
81' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Inaki Williams.
80' Abdul Mumin (Rayo Vallecano) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
76' Ath Bilbao seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
76' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 7:1.
74' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Iker Muniain (Ath Bilbao) replacing Oihan Sancet.
74' Substitution. Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Oscar de Marcos walks off.

73' Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and tries to catch the keeper out, but the shot lacks accuracy and curls well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.
73' Rayo Vallecano work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

72' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao have been awarded a corner kick.
71' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Kike Perez (Rayo Vallecano) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Unai Simon easily catches the ball.
69' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Radamel Falcao (Rayo Vallecano) will replace Sergio Camello.
68' 4 - 0 Goal! Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the bottom right corner.
67' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
64' 3 - 0 Goal Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao)! Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) was put through by Gorka Guruzeta and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the bottom right corner. 3:0.
62' Poor challenge! Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) is penalised for tripping and Francisco Maeso blows his whistle.
60' The Rayo Vallecano players are exchanging some short passes.

59' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) wins the battle with the defender and plants a header goalwards from the corner, but his effort from around the penalty spot sails harmlessly past the right post. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao will have a goal kick.
58' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) steps up to send the ball in.
58' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Rayo Vallecano earn a corner.
57' 6:5 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
55' The referee allows time for a substitution. Isi Palazon will be replaced by Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano).
55' Substitution. Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) in, Unai Lopez out.
55' Francisco has decided to substitute Oscar Valentin and he is replaced by Kike Perez (Rayo Vallecano).

53' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) gets a nice pass from Nico Williams on the edge of the box, he looks up and tries to beat the keeper in the corner but it goes just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
52' The resulting set piece from Ath Bilbao is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

51' A pass lands at the feet of Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. The linesman makes the right call and Ath Bilbao will have a corner.
47' 2 - 0 The score has changed! Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano) turned the ball into his own net.

46' What a chance! Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) squanders a promising opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes just wide of the right post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Half-chance! Ander Herrera (Ath Bilbao) plays a pass into the box, but Stole Dimitrievski reacts well to snuff out the attack.
45+1' Ath Bilbao take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
44' The ratio of the ball possession is 56:44.
42' Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
42' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) picks up a long through ball, but Unai Simon deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
40' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
39' The free kick from long range, taken by Rayo Vallecano, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.
38' Foul! Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) is penalised for pulling back his opponent. Rayo Vallecano win a free kick.
37' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) makes a rough challenge and Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for a foul. Rayo Vallecano are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
35' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) is flagged for offside.
33' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
32' Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Francisco Maeso had an easy-decision to make.
31' Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
29' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.

27' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) skips perfectly past challenges but misdirects his shot from the edge of the box. The ball flies a few yards wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.
25' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.

23' 1 - 0 Goal! Oihan Sancet displays great vision and sends a pass to Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom right corner. The score is 1:0.
23' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) leaps highest to meet the resulting set piece and sends his header way off target. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
23' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
22' Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. Ath Bilbao will take a corner kick.
19' Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) sends a cross into the box, but Stole Dimitrievski comes off his line to gather the ball.
15' Celebrations are cut short for Ath Bilbao as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
15' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Ath Bilbao players aren’t happy.
14' A sweet pass is collected by Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) inside the penalty box and he unleashes a brilliant shot which goes into the roof of the net and behind the goalkeeper.
13' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
13' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Ath Bilbao.
11' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is out of play. Rayo Vallecano will take a throw-in.
10' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.

8' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.
7' Francisco Maeso blows his whistle and signals a foul after Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao) brought his opponent down. Rayo Vallecano have a free kick.
6' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
4' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
2' Ath Bilbao take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
2' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Ath Bilbao. Ath Bilbao have been awarded a corner kick.

1' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Ath Bilbao.
